name: Review NewEra Phase Completion
description: Kiểm tra evidence, report, residual work và trạng thái nghiệm thu sau khi task kết thúc.

then.prompt: Review the completed NewEra task. Check requirements, task status, tests, evidence, report, residual work, commit and acceptance status. Run `python3 scripts/newera_validate.py --state .newera/project-state.json` when structured references exist; use `--strict` before checkpoint. Keep CHECKPOINT_PENDING distinct from ACCEPTED and report any missing artifact. Do not mark acceptance automatically.
